newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico Cetes rate jumps on tight liquidity.
newsitem.headline: Mexico Cetes rate jumps on tight liquidity.

text.p: Mexican overnight Cetes rates closed up 115 basis points at 23.90 percent on Thursday due to a late liquidity squeeze, dealers said.
"It was down to one big player witholding money, you just don't get such a shortfall so suddenly," a trader said. "I expect rates to trend downwards again tomorrow."
Other traders said liquidity was short due to the central bank's decision to drain 1.502 billion pesos from the system, rather than its far more usual injection.
"Banco de Mexico probably drained too much liquidity," another trader said.
